denied: You are not allowed to do this. Ask the person who manages the site.
empty: Nothing is planned right now. Come back soon!
emptyAdmin: You have no countdown yet. All it takes is a name, a day and a time: fill in the form below.
err_date: Pick a day in the calendar, for example 2026-11-14.
err_end_before: The end must come after the start. Check the last day and the end time.
err_end_time: Also write the end time, for example 23:00.
err_image: Pick an image uploaded to the site, or write an address starting with https://.
err_keep: Pick a delay from the list.
err_link: Write a full address, for example https://www.example.org/my-page.
err_time: Write the time, for example 21:00 or 9:30 pm (or tick “All day”).
err_title: Give the event a name, for example “My game launch”.
err_zone: This time zone does not exist. Write its official name, for example Asia/Tokyo or America/Montreal.
fAllDayHelp: For a birthday or a convention: the countdown aims at the start of the day.
fDateHelp: The day in the time zone chosen below.
fDescriptionHelp: A few sentences shown on the event page and in the calendar.
fEndHelp: For an event over several days or with an end time. Used for your visitors’ calendar, and the end message stays shown until then.
fEndMessageHelp: Shown when the time has come. Empty: the message from your settings, otherwise “It’s on!”.
fFeaturedHelp: It comes first on the home page and in OBS. Only one at a time. With no choice, the next event is the featured one.
fImageHelp: Shown at the top of the event page.
fKeep: Keep shown once it has started
fKeepHelp: After this delay the event disappears from the site by itself.
fTimeHelp: Example: 21:00 or 9:30 pm. Not needed for an all-day event.
fZoneHelp: Summer and winter time are handled for you. Your visitors will see the time where they live.
fZoneOtherHelp: Only if it is missing from the list, for example Asia/Kolkata. It replaces the choice above.
intro: For a one-off date: release, launch, birthday, convention. Your regular streams are managed in the “Stream schedule” module.
linkCalendar: Address of this event’s calendar file (.ics)
linkObs: Address to paste in OBS for this exact event
moreOptionsHint: To add an end message, a description, a place or an image, click “Edit” next to your event.
notFound: This event no longer exists. It may have been deleted.
noteFold: This time happens twice that day (clocks go back): the first one is used.
noteGap: This time does not exist that day (clocks go forward): the event is placed at {time}.
notePassed: This event is already in the past: it will disappear after the chosen delay.
pageDescription: Upcoming dates, with the time left before each one.
pastHelp: They are no longer visible on the site. Keep them to reuse next year, or delete them.
tooMany: You already have {max} events. Delete the oldest ones (“Hidden events” section) to add more.
whereToShow: To show a countdown on your home page: open “Home page” in the menu, then add the “Featured countdown” piece. For your stream, paste in OBS the address shown in the “My events” tab. The look, place and size below only apply to OBS.
